turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
es it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
menu
Orders placed by 12:00 PM EST (Monday through Friday) are processed and shipped out the same day.
Orders placed on weekends, holidays, or after 12:00 PM EST are processed on the following business day. On rare occasions, items that are temporarily out of stock can take up to 7 business days to ship.
Once your package ships, a tracking number is automatically generated and sent to your email. Is there anything else I can help you with?

For international orders, shipping timelines are quoted based on the time it takes to leave the U.S., though customs inspections in your destination country may add extra time.
